nombre: Avasory · a Shopify store that could save hours with automation
descripcion: A small or mid-size DTC brand on Shopify selling in the US, with a manageable catalog and customers who ask the same things again and again (shipping, returns, sizing, product use).

criterios.nombre: Sells and ships in the US
criterios.como: the quote itself mentions shipping to the US or the United States, or prices in USD
questions (lines ending in ?) on the FAQ and policy pages: 10 or more is yes, 4 to 9 is partly
the pages say the founder still runs the company or that the team is small (a founding story alone is not enough)
invites visitors to sign up for emails, a newsletter or a first-order discount
